title: onboarding
description: The specification onboarding-doc-generator composes in Decide and hands to scripts/render_onboarding.py (SDS-S-080, a skill-local shape). An onboarding guide is the README plus what the tree cannot show: the access a newcomer must be granted and by whom, setup steps each paired with how to verify it worked, a first task small enough to finish in a day, and who to ask about what. Setup commands are structured so the script can check them against the repository's declared commands.

audience.description: Who this is for, e.g. 'a backend engineer joining the checkout team'.

grantedBy.description: A person, role, or request path — never 'someone'.

command.description: The exact command, when there is one; checked against the repository's declared commands.

verify.description: What the newcomer should see when it worked. Empty means unverifiable and is refused.

done.description: How the newcomer knows it is finished.

lastVerified.description: The last date a newcomer actually followed this guide end to end.
